data.content_ref: inline:The mechanism asserts: 'Unlike every previously studied system of this kind, which faced identical structural constraints yet exhibited none of this behaviour.' This is a self-defeating universal negative. The entire target is an explication of Popperian falsificationism — the mechanism opens by naming 'Popperian science' as the system exhibiting the error-minimization behavior. Popper's epistemology is itself a 'previously studied system of this kind' (a system for theory preference under fallibilism), and it already exhibits exactly this behavior: preferring theories that survived severe tests, explicitly disclaiming truth-probability as the basis for preference. So the target simultaneously (a) identifies Popperian science as the locus of the behavior and (b) denies that any previously studied system exhibited the behavior. This is a direct internal contradiction, and it makes the novelty claim an unsupported falsehood rather than a defensible conjecture.
